response.sql: WITH timing_averages AS (SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS avg_instownpct FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY eventannotm), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_instownpct) AS baseline_avg FROM timing_averages) SELECT AVG(t.avg_instownpct) AS mean_above_baseline, AVG(t.avg_instownpct - b.baseline_avg) AS mean_excess FROM timing_averages AS t CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE t.avg_instownpct > b.baseline_avg
